approvers: Owner decides alone; glazing subcontractor and developer would have to agree
reason: The glazing subcontractor is responsible for damage until handover, not me, so I have no budget line for this. At about 19 euro per m2 against cheap film and tape that we already use, it is not something I would add on a small block.
objection: It is a new cost for a risk that sits with the glazing sub, and I compare cost per m2 with film and tape. There is also no Maltese reference job yet, so I would be the guinea pig.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape on the frames and leave handover damage with the glazing subcontractor.
would_change_my_mind: A Maltese reference on a similar small block and a price near film and tape, or a glazing sub or developer who asks for it and pays for it.
